title: Scaled Dot-Product Self-Attention Head
summary: Implement softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V with batching and causal masking, then wrap it in a learnable single attention head.

ShapeMismatch.hint: Matrix shapes don't line up. Write down (…, T, d) for Q, K and V and check which axes each matmul contracts.

NaNInSoftmax.hint: Your softmax is overflowing. Revisit the max-subtraction trick.

hints.test_softmax_sums_to_one: Normalize by the sum along the same axis you exponentiate over, with keepdims=True.
hints.test_softmax_is_numerically_stable: exp(1000) overflows. Softmax is invariant to shifting all logits, so subtract the max first.
hints.test_softmax_respects_axis: Pass axis through to both max and sum.
hints.test_causal_mask: Query i may see keys 0…i, which is the lower triangle including the diagonal.
hints.test_attention_unbatched_matches_referen: Scores are Q @ Kᵀ, shape (T_q, T_k). Softmax runs over the key axis, then multiply by V.
hints.test_attention_batched_matches_reference: .T reverses every axis of a batched tensor. Swap only the last two axes.
hints.test_scaling_by_sqrt_dk_is_applied: Divide the scores by √d_k before the softmax, where d_k is Q's last dimension.
hints.test_masked_positions_get_zero_weight: Set masked scores to -inf before softmax so they get exactly zero weight.
hints.test_dimension_mismatch_raises: Compare Q.shape[-1] and K.shape[-1] before doing any math.
hints.test_head_weight_shapes: Each projection maps d_model features to d_head features.
hints.test_head_forward_matches_reference: Project X with W_q, W_k and W_v, then reuse your attention function.
hints.test_head_is_deterministic_per_seed: Build every weight from a single np.random.default_rng(seed).
hints.test_causal_head_ignores_future_tokens: Build the mask from the sequence length (X.shape[-2]) and pass it through when causal=True.
hints.test_unmasked_attention_is_permutation_e: Without positional information, attention shouldn't depend on token order. Look for anything position-specific.
